the addition of phytase to low-P diets can increase the P digestibility, and thus reduce the amount of P excreted, without compromising the performance and carcass traits of pigs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the inclusion of phytase in the diet can be an effective way of reducing the phosphorus content of the feed without negatively impacting the performance of the pigs.
